kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننحرف (form VII)
# نَنْحَرِفُ (nanḥarifu) /nan.ħa.ri.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْحَرَفَ (inḥarafa)
# نَنْحَرِفَ (nanḥarifa) /nan.ħa.ri.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَرَفَ (inḥarafa)
# نَنْحَرِفْ (nanḥarif) /nan.ħa.rif/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْحَرَفَ (inḥarafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
